user.title: Select Marstek device
user.description: Choose a discovered device, or enter its IP address manually.

manual.title: Connect to Marstek Venus
manual.description: Enter the IP address of your Marstek Venus device

discovery_confirm.title: Marstek Venus discovered
discovery_confirm.description: Do you want to set up the Marstek Venus device at {host}?

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Marstek Venus
reconfigure.description: Update the device's IP address or UDP port. The device must be reachable to save.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to device. Please check the IP address and ensure the device is on the network and its local API is enabled.
error.timeout: Connection timed out. Please check your network and device status.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration of this device is already in progress.
abort.wrong_device: That IP belongs to a different Marstek device than the one being reconfigured.

init.title: Configure Marstek Venus
init.description: Configure update intervals and optional sensors

data_description.auto_reassert_schedule: After the device recovers from an outage, re-apply the saved Manual schedule. Forces the device into Manual mode on recovery.

error.invalid_scan_interval: Scan interval must be between 15 and 300 seconds
error.invalid_timeout: Timeout must be between 5 and 30 seconds

confirm.title: Reconnect to the Marstek Venus
confirm.description: Home Assistant stopped receiving data from the device. Check that it is powered on, connected to the network, and that its local API is still enabled in the Marstek app. Then submit to retry the connection.
